answer_1.quote: LLMs show promise in generating clinical notes

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the reward model's ability to select the superior note within the Best-of-N framework using two key metrics: (1) Accuracy of selecting the gold-reference note ... and (2) Accuracy of selecting the physician-preferred note

answer_3.quote: Baseline We compare our PRM against several strong baselines, including LLM-as-a-judge setups using Gemini Pro 1.0, Gemini Pro 1.5, OpenAI's GPT-4o, o1, and o3mini.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a comprehensive reader study involving nine physicians.
answer_4.guideline: Physicians evaluated the top-scoring notes to select the preferred one.
